name: solidity-collateral-lending-pool
title: Collateralized token lending pool
description: Pooled ERC20 loans against native collateral with stale-oracle checks, bounded liquidation and share accounting.
assumptions: Zero-interest lending with native collateral and a centralized owner-updated price. Price units are loan base units per 1e18 native units. LP redemption depends on liquid pool balance. Liquidation can be partial; tiny residual collateral can cause debt writeoff. Not intended for live financial use without oracle integration and review.
